channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Tom Brady | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Tom Brady from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: A'ja Wilson on Tom Brady
item.description:
“Sometimes I feel like we’re in our own way of games and possessions, where if we just step aside and really see what we have, the greatness that we have, the chips will fall where they may. But Tom Brady would always say that you’re never focused on your other championships, you’re focused on the next one.”

A'ja Wilson on Tom Brady, Aug 20, 2026. Source: Las Vegas Review Journal.

item.title: Rudy Gobert on Kyle Korver, Mike Conley, Cristiano Ronaldo, Tom Brady
item.description:
Rudy Gobert:

“Yeah. Yeah. The first time I heard about a hyperbaric chamber, I was in Utah, and it was Kyle Korver. I know Tom Brady had one, Cristiano Ronaldo had one. Since I’m someone who wants to optimize my potential, I ordered one right away. I even gave one to Mike Conley. You always have to take care of your point guards.”

Rudy Gobert on Kyle Korver, Mike Conley, Cristiano Ronaldo, Tom Brady, Mar 17, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Joe Lacob on Tom Brady
item.description:
Lacob said last week in a Chronicle interview.

“He’s not going to play forever, though I do think he may play longer than we all think. He might be the Tom Brady of the NBA.… “I look forward to it in a way probably no one else can understand, because it will be a tremendous challenge to try to replicate what we’ve done in the first 15 years over the next 15. But I’m looking forward to that, because it’s something we want to try to do — to prove we do a good job and it’s not just Steph Curry.”

Joe Lacob on Tom Brady, Nov 13, 2025. Source: San Francisco Chronicle.

item.title: Klay Thompson on Shaquille O'Neal, Tom Brady
item.description:
“But I mean, I've seen some of my favorite athletes pivot and have tremendous success. When I think of Shaq[uille O'Neal] leaving the Lakers and winning a ring or Tom Brady winning one with Tampa Bay, it's been done before.”

Klay Thompson on Shaquille O'Neal, Tom Brady, Nov 12, 2024. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Shaquille O'Neal on Tom Brady, David Beckham
item.description:
O’Neal told The Messenger.

“The fact that I have David Beckham’s number and Tom Brady’s number in my phone, it doesn’t get any bigger than that.”

Shaquille O'Neal on Tom Brady, David Beckham, Nov 19, 2023. Source: The Messenger.

item.title: LeBron James on Tom Brady
item.description:
He mentioned NFL legend Tom Brady of the Tampa Bay Buccaneers as someone who, despite being 45 years old and being a frequent inhabitant of the injury report, always suits up on the field.

“Tom Brady’s been on the injury report for like 20 straight years. Somehow he just plays,”

LeBron James on Tom Brady, Nov 3, 2022. Source: Clutch Points.

item.title: LeBron James on Tom Brady
item.description:
“When I saw how much [Tom Brady] signed for, you’re god damn right I did. I want to stay around the game forever.”

LeBron James on Tom Brady, Jun 11, 2022. Source: Larry Brown Sports.

item.title: Joe Lacob on Tom Brady
item.description:
Lacob believes Curry has much more left in the tank.

“Well, Tom Brady’s 44 now. I tell Steph all the time, ‘Do whatever he does. Whatever he does, you do.’ I told him that,”

Joe Lacob on Tom Brady, Jan 10, 2022. Source: Yahoo! Sports.

item.title: CJ McCollum on Tom Brady
item.description:
According to the Blazers guard, he understands and respects Brady’s decision here, and even said that he was going to buy Brady’s new Bucs jersey.

“I am a huge Browns fan, but I’m not going to lie to you, I will be getting a Tom Brady Tampa Bay Buccaneers jersey,”

CJ McCollum on Tom Brady, Mar 21, 2020. Source: Clutch Points.

item.title: LeBron James on Tom Brady
item.description:
Kyle Goon:LeBron says of considering retirement:

“Me and Tom Brady are one and the same. We're gonna play until we can't walk no more.”

LeBron James on Tom Brady, Nov 15, 2019. Source: Twitter @kylegoon.

item.title: Paul Millsap on Tom Brady
item.description:
“I consider him like a Tom Brady. He's always going to pick you apart and make the right reads. Commend him for doing that at this stage in his career. It's unbelievable.”

Paul Millsap on Tom Brady, Apr 30, 2019. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Isaiah Thomas on Kobe Bryant, Floyd Mayweather, Brad Stevens, Tom Brady
item.description:
“That's just what I was going to do, no matter what. The people that helped me were my family -- my parents, my close friends, the Celtics organization, Brad Stevens, coaching staff, my teammates and so many guys reached out. Floyd Mayweather, Tom Brady, Kobe Bryant. I remember Kobe texting me and calling me and telling me nobody can tell you what to do, but if you do play then play to be the killer that you are and leave it all out there on the floor. I took that to heart.”

Isaiah Thomas on Kobe Bryant, Floyd Mayweather, Brad Stevens, Tom Brady, Nov 16, 2017. Source: Cleveland Plain Dealer.

item.title: LeBron James on Tom Brady
item.description:
LeBron James hopped on social media late Sunday to congratulate fellow superstar Tom Brady following the quarterback's record-setting fifth Super Bowl championship, a remarkable 34-28 overtime comeback in which the Patriots rallied from 25 points down to stun the Falcons.

“A major salute to the G.O.A.T. (greatest of all time), Mr. Tom Brady, on your fifth championship,”

LeBron James on Tom Brady, Feb 6, 2017. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Tyronn Lue on LeBron James, Kyrie Irving, Tom Brady, Bill Belichick
item.description:
“Keep believing. With the Patriots and our team, we have greats. Having LeBron James on your team, Kyrie [Irving], who is great, and then having a Tom Brady and one of the best coaches of all time in all sports [Bill Belichick], you just got to have that belief. And when you have someone to will you home and will you all the way in, it's tough to beat. And that's what they did last night,”

Tyronn Lue on LeBron James, Kyrie Irving, Tom Brady, Bill Belichick, Feb 6, 2017. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Isaiah Thomas on Tom Brady
item.description:
Also, after they exchanged numbers at the Durant pitch in the Hamptons, Thomas now casually exchanges text messages with New England Patriots quarterback Tom Brady.

“It's crazy to see Tom Brady's name on my phone. It doesn't seem real. Just like playing for the Celtics and being that guy doesn't seem real,”

Isaiah Thomas on Tom Brady, Nov 2, 2016. Source: ESPN.
